summary: Join our Advanced Agribusiness Management Training Course to develop essential skills and knowledge for thriving in the competitive agribusiness sector.
lede: Agribusiness management connects agricultural production with the financial, market and operational decisions needed to run a viable enterprise. This training is for agribusiness managers, farm enterprise owners, cooperative leaders and other professionals responsible for developing or scaling agricultural businesses. It covers financial planning, market opportunity assessment and value chain optimization, while building skills to identify risks and create business growth strategies.
audienceIntro: This advanced agribusiness management training is designed for:
audience: Supply chain managers in food and agriculture
modules: Financial Planning and Investment in Agribusiness
Leadership and Governance in Agribusiness Organizations
